components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      x-class-extra-annotation: "@org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.PostcodeValidation @org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.AddressRequired"
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: Optional honorific title of the pet owner (MR/MRS/MS/DR).
          type: string
          example: DR
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted for backward
            compatibility; when the structured addressLine1 is supplied it is the
            composed, normalized address returned in responses.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '^.*\S.*$'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: The first line of the owner's structured postal address.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '^.*\S.*$'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: An optional second line of the owner's structured postal address.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '^.*\S.*$'
          example: 'Apartment 4B'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string

## Summary

Added a `capacityWarning` flag that is `true` when the owner's city already holds 40–49 owners at create time (approaching the hard limit of 50, which is unchanged).

The change is spread across small, cohesive units, keeping structural impact low:

- **`OwnerRestControllerV1.addOwner`** — one added line, alongside the existing `owner.set…Warning(...)` calls, reusing the existing `CityCodes.countInCity` helper: `owner.setCapacityWarning(CityCodes.countInCity(owners, owner) >= 40);`. Since the `>= 50` guard above already rejects anything at/over the limit, `>= 40` here means exactly the 40–49 band. No new branch, so the method's cyclomatic complexity is unchanged.
- **`Owner`** — a new `capacity_warning` column field plus a null-safe getter/setter mirroring the existing `bulkSignupWarning` pattern (each a trivial CC-1 accessor). MapStruct maps it to the DTO automatically by name.
- **`openapi.yml`** — a read-only `capacityWarning` boolean property so the generated `OwnerDto` exposes it in the JSON response.
- **`db/hsqldb/schema.sql`** / **`db/hsqldb/data.sql`** — added the `capacity_warning BOOLEAN` column and the matching seed value in the positional inserts.

No existing method grew in complexity; behaviour was added as small new units.
